title: Improve test coverage and revert uv.lock
body:
Revert https://github.com/duckdb/duckdb/pull/25974. It's [documented](https://docs.astral.sh/uv/concepts/projects/layout/#the-lockfile) to be checked in:

> [...] the lockfile contains the exact resolved versions that are installed in the project environment. This file should be checked into version control, allowing for consistent and reproducible installations across machines.

Increase code test coverage:
- Exclude `build/` and more custom runtime exceptions in lcov exclude list.
- Filter not-covered, closed brace.
- Add simple, missing test cases for json extension.
- Add more parquet test coverage.

Coverage of `extensions/` went from `89.7%` to `92.4%`.
